ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.45:0.55 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white regions occupy the lateral portions of both lobes. The left lobe white region is partially bisected by a black intrusion from the medial side. The right lobe features a broad white field with a small, isolated black spot near the distal tip. The central peduncle and base are solid black.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central depression dividing the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular serrated trailing edge with continuous pixel-level variations in amplitude (peaks and valleys) visible against the background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trajectory sweeping upwards and outwards towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Isolated dark circular pixel clusters detected on the white field of the distal right lobe and the mid-lateral left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Fine, dark, vertically oriented linear markings visible on the white pigmented fields of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple circular dark marks on white pigmented areas, consistent with healed attachment sites or scarring.
other_distinctive_markers: High-intensity white pixel clusters at the base of the fluke representing water-surface interaction (splash).
